frequency_question: What proportion of announced or executed central bank liquidity management tools properly satisfy formal official notification and dating criteria within the specified window?
membership_rule: Includes any primary central bank liquidity adjustment tool or reserve ratio variation implemented via circular, press release, or notification within a designated timeframe. Excludes informal verbal guidance not backed by formal text.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named; standard regulatory practice in this jurisdiction consistently uses formal notifications for reserve ratio adjustments.
known_gaps: Potential for ambiguity if implemented via unannounced operational tweaks rather than explicit press releases, though statutory ratios require formal notification.
skeleton: named cases of central bank statutory tool implementations meeting formal gazette/notification requirements
multiplier: 4 hits out of 4 total historical implementations
validity_reason: Central bank statutory notification procedures and legal requirements for reserve ratios change very slowly over decades.
